text:
Maya Lopez: Heads-up on Marlineg onboarding. p95 drifted to ~360ms last 48h (we aim for 250ms) and token cost +25% vs forecast. Renewal intro in ~7w. Leaning toward a small int8 canary + route doc-heavy traffic to a compact model. Thoughts?
Ethan Wu: Agree on canary. Do we have a breakdown by session length or tags?
Maya Lopez: Most of the tail is long-context chat with multi-doc lookups. I exported a 24h sample to the dashboard.
Ravi Singh: int8 should cut p95, but keep quality gates tight. Suggest 3% global canary + route any request with meta.doc_count > 0 to compact-q-lite for lower-priority flows.
CSM - Claire Zhou: Customer wants no surprises for billing-sensitive endpoints. Can we exclude billing-verification flows from routing?
Maya Lopez: Yes exclude endpoints with tag `billing_sensitive`. Also need a short ops snippet for their SREs.
Ravi Singh: Rollout snippet: ```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"endpoint":"/chat/generate","policy":"canary","percent":3,"model":"marlineg-int8-rc1","exclude_tags":["billing_sensitive"]},
    {"endpoint":"/chat/generate","policy":"route","match":{"meta.doc_count":{"gt":0},"meta.priority":"low"},"model":"compact-q-lite"}
  ]
}
```
Ethan Wu: ops-bot run perf-smoke comparing marlineg-int8-rc1 vs marlineg-fp16 on 400 anonymized traces, include p50/p95/p99 and token-cost delta.
ops-bot: Job scheduled: perf-smoke/498765-a. Samples: 400. ETA ~30m. I will post results.
Maya Lopez: Quality gate: `eval-suite run --customer marlineg --suite onboard-critical --min-avg 0.97` fail triggers immediate rollback. Also track hallucination rate and exact-match on key prompts.
ops-bot: perf-smoke/498765-a finished: p95 down 12%, p99 down 7%, token cost per request -13%. Eval-suite avg = 97.4%. Logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/498765-a
CSM - Claire Zhou: These look like a safe win. Customer ok with a staged ramp if we document rollback options.
Ravi Singh: Ramp plan: 24h @3% -> 24h @20% for `low` priority docs -> 48h @50% overall. Auto-rollback if eval-suite <97% or p99 increases. I'll prepare a rollback playbook with exact commands to flip the rules and revoke model alias.
Ethan Wu: Also schedule a short UAT with their ops during a low-traffic window and capture a one-line ops quote for the renewal deck after 20% step.
Maya Lopez: Action items: Maya -> coordinate UAT window + customer comms; Ethan -> update renewal slide with baseline vs expected; Ravi -> rollback playbook + runbook; Claire -> get SRE signoff for the exclusion list.
CSM - Claire Zhou: I'll confirm exclusion list and request the midnight window next Tuesday.
Maya Lopez: Thanks team I'll post the enablement doc and the SRE snippet link once ready. :rocket:
